subject: alice-persistent-id

fixtures.name: 01-valid-response-signed
fixtures.description: Response signed (RSA-SHA256, exclusive c14n); assertion unsigned.

fixtures.name: 02-valid-assertion-signed
fixtures.description: Assertion signed; response unsigned.

fixtures.name: 03-valid-both-signed
fixtures.description: Assertion signed, then the response signed over it.

fixtures.name: 04-valid-encrypted-oaep-gcm
fixtures.description: Signed assertion encrypted to the SP (RSA-OAEP key transport, AES-256-GCM); response signed.

package.note: AES-256-GCM is unusable in xml-security 2.x and out until saml2 v7 (docs/design/saml-library.md, condition 5).

fixtures.name: 05-valid-encrypted-oaep-aes128-gcm
fixtures.description: As 04 with AES-128-GCM content encryption.

fixtures.name: 10-tampered-nameid
fixtures.description: Response signed, then the NameID changed.

fixtures.name: 11-untrusted-key-embedded-cert
fixtures.description: Response signed by an untrusted key whose certificate is carried in KeyInfo.

fixtures.name: 12-unsigned
fixtures.description: No signature on the response or the assertion.

fixtures.name: 20-xsw1
fixtures.description: XSW1: evil response at the root carrying the signature; the signed original response inside ds:Signature.

fixtures.name: 21-xsw2
fixtures.description: XSW2: evil response at the root; the signed original response as a detached sibling before the signature.

fixtures.name: 22-xsw3
fixtures.description: XSW3: unsigned evil assertion (new ID) before the signed assertion.

fixtures.name: 23-xsw4
fixtures.description: XSW4: the signed assertion nested as the last child of an unsigned evil assertion.

fixtures.name: 24-xsw5
fixtures.description: XSW5: evil assertion carries the signature; the unsigned original appended at the end of the response.

fixtures.name: 25-xsw6
fixtures.description: XSW6: evil assertion carries the signature; the unsigned original inside that ds:Signature.

fixtures.name: 26-xsw7
fixtures.description: XSW7: the signed assertion inside samlp:Extensions; an unsigned evil assertion in the assertion position.

fixtures.name: 27-xsw8
fixtures.description: XSW8: evil assertion carries the signature; the unsigned original inside ds:Object in that signature.

fixtures.name: 28-xsw-same-id-before
fixtures.description: Unsigned evil assertion with the same ID as the signed assertion, placed before it.

fixtures.name: 29-xsw-same-id-after
fixtures.description: Unsigned evil assertion with the same ID as the signed assertion, placed after it.

fixtures.name: 30-dup-id-response-and-assertion
fixtures.description: Response and assertion share one ID; the response is signed (reference #_dup-0001).

fixtures.name: 31-dup-id-two-signed-assertions
fixtures.description: Two identical signed assertions with the same ID; the response signed over both.

fixtures.name: 40-comment-in-nameid-response-signed
fixtures.description: Signed NameID "alice-persistent-id.mallory" split by a comment after "alice-persistent-id"; response signed.

fixtures.name: 41-comment-in-nameid-assertion-signed
fixtures.description: As 40, with the assertion signed instead of the response.

fixtures.name: 42-pi-in-nameid-response-signed
fixtures.description: As 40, split by a processing instruction instead of a comment.

package.note: Canonicalisation keeps processing instructions, so one inserted after signing breaks the digest.

fixtures.name: 50-doctype-unused
fixtures.description: A valid signed response with an internal DTD subset that declares an unused entity.

fixtures.name: 51-xxe-external-entity
fixtures.description: External entity (file:// URL of xxe-secret.txt) referenced from the NameID; must never be read.

fixtures.name: 52-entity-expansion
fixtures.description: Nested internal entities (10^4 expansion, deliberately small) referenced from the NameID.

fixtures.name: 53-external-dtd
fixtures.description: External DTD by SYSTEM identifier on a closed local port; must not be fetched.

fixtures.name: 54-xxe-utf16
fixtures.description: As 51, encoded as UTF-16LE with a BOM so that a byte-level "<!DOCTYPE" search does not match.

fixtures.name: 60-rsa-sha1
fixtures.description: Response signed with RSA-SHA1 and a SHA-1 digest.

fixtures.name: 61-sha1-digest
fixtures.description: Response signed with RSA-SHA256 but a SHA-1 reference digest.

fixtures.name: 62-encrypted-rsa15-cbc
fixtures.description: Signed assertion encrypted with RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport and AES-128-CBC; response signed.

fixtures.name: 63-encrypted-rsa15-gcm
fixtures.description: Signed assertion encrypted with RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport and AES-256-GCM; response signed.

fixtures.name: 64-encrypted-oaep-cbc
fixtures.description: Signed assertion encrypted with RSA-OAEP and AES-128-CBC (allowed only by opt-in); response signed.

package.note: AES-CBC is decrypted only when the connection lists it, and then only after a verified response signature.

fixtures.name: 70-multiple-assertions
fixtures.description: Two validly signed assertions (alice, then mallory) in a signed response.

fixtures.name: 71-unsigned-assertion-beside-signed
fixtures.description: Unsigned response: a signed assertion followed by an injected unsigned assertion.

fixtures.name: 72-response-signature-references-assertion
fixtures.description: ds:Signature in the response whose Reference names the assertion (#_assert-0001), not the response.

fixtures.name: 73-signed-response-assertion-signature-other-id
fixtures.description: Signed response; the assertion carries a signature whose reference names a different ID (#_assert-0001 on an assertion now _assert-0002), so that signature cannot verify.

fixtures.name: 74-empty-uri-reference
fixtures.description: Response signed with Reference URI="" (whole document) instead of a same-document #id.

fixtures.name: 75-c14n-with-comments
fixtures.description: Response signed with exclusive c14n WithComments as the SignedInfo canonicalisation.

fixtures.name: 76-schema-invalid-order
fixtures.description: Signed response whose assertion has Conditions before Subject (invalid against the SAML 2.0 schema).

description: The BL-0A adversarial fixtures. expect is the outcome SSO-6 requires; package is the outcome the package adapter gives under the default policy (RSA-SHA256, RSA-OAEP, AES-128/192-GCM), with with_cbc for AES-CBC listed. {{FIXTURES}} in 51 and 54 stands for this directory.
